conflicts.title: International has nothing in it
conflicts.fact: The target is 5% international, but no fund is listed. The $700 left over is called a cash reserve.
conflicts.question: Is that share meant to be international or cash?

conflicts.title: CEG and VST act like one bet
conflicts.fact: Their weekly moves had a correlation of 0.80 over two years (1 means identical). Together they are 21% of the plan, above the 15% limit for one position.
conflicts.question: Does the 15% limit count linked stocks together?

conflicts.title: The 30% stop-loss is inside normal swings
conflicts.fact: Worst fall from a high in five years (or since listing): CEG 51%, MSFT 37%, RDDT 68%, VST 49%.
conflicts.question: What should make you sell: a price fall, or a change in the business?

conflicts.title: Limit and trim rule differ
conflicts.fact: No position may exceed 15%, but trimming starts at 20%.
conflicts.question: What happens between 15% and 20%?
